title: Lovono language
description: Endangered Oceanic language of the Solomon Islands
extract: Lovono is a nearly extinct language of the island of Vanikoro in the easternmost province of the Solomon Islands. As of 2012, it is only spoken by four speakers; it has been replaced by the island's dominant language, Teanu.
